name: frontend-testing
description: Use for frontend unit, component, integration, and end-to-end testing with tools such as Vitest, Jest, Testing Library, and Playwright.

# Frontend Testing

Test behavior users depend on:
- Form validation.
- Navigation.
- Permissions-visible behavior.
- Loading/error states.
- API interactions.
- Dynamic tables.
- Critical workflows.

Prefer user-facing queries over implementation-specific selectors.
Use E2E tests for critical multi-page/business workflows.
